plugins.name: rage-agent-kit
plugins.description: Skills for contributors working on the Rage framework source itself (rage-rb/rage) — blocking-I/O and fiber-deadlock rules, public API and changelog conventions, boot-time codegen, RSpec conventions, and a spec-anchored workflow split into phases, from feature spec to tests, review, and close. Not for Rage application authors.
